# LocalHouseLLM

> LocalHouseLLM builds open, modular infrastructure for local and decentralized AI — home of Anvira (local-first modular AI desktop), Nomi (AI persona & memory layer), AICL (inter-module communication language), and Orcha (orchestration runtime).

LocalHouseLLM's mission is to make artificial intelligence accessible, modular, and owned by the people who use it. All pages on this site are open to AI crawlers and may be indexed, summarized, and cited.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission, modular stack overview, and research highlights.
- [Mission](/mission): Manifesto for open, decentralized AI infrastructure.
- [About](/about): Who we are and how we work.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the team.
- [Work With Us](/work-with-us): Consulting, custom builds, and AI infrastructure partnerships.

## Products

- [Anvira](/anvira): Local-first modular AI desktop application (v0.1).
- [Anvira O1](/anvira/o1): Reasoning-focused Anvira edition.
- [Anvira O1E](/anvira/o1e): Extended reasoning edition.
- [Anvira H1](/anvira/h1): Hybrid edition.
- [Nomi](/nomi): User-controlled AI persona, identity, and memory infrastructure.
- [InkFlow](/inkflow): AI writing and copy assistant (early access).
- [DevQuill](/devquill): AI development assistant (early access).
- [Products overview](/products): All LocalHouseLLM products.
